Tracking ID: `energyInfrastructure/EI01`

Umbrella: [EI00](https://github.com/jateeter/RealityEngine_Machines/issues/264)

## Outcome and current gap

Publish the specification baseline and issue traceability. The current domain is a planning package with 187 unchanged legacy definitions, 43 unrun cases, no admitted new identity, and no verified domain-specific software/model/simulator integration. Publishing this issue does not complete its implementation work.

## Acceptance basis

Every required hardware component is simulated required hardware. Template/generic assets may be used in every case. EI04 supplies templates for asset classes defined by associated applicable standards; EI18 verifies every required hardware dependency has a versioned simulated counterpart. Actual software, cryptographic endpoints, engine/model/adapter behavior and authentic independent review/admission receipts remain genuine. Physical procurement, customer-site/OEM records, CHIL/PHIL labs and physical commissioning do not gate corpus acceptance. Simulation is not physical equipment certification.

## Ownership and dependencies

- Accountable roles: Domain owner; Documentation reviewer. Named owners remain to be assigned.
- Responsible source repositories: RealityEngine_Machines. This issue stays in RealityEngine_Machines; sibling PRs link back here.
- Blocked by: None.

- [ ] Review the simulation-only acceptance decision across package docs, cases, profiles and inventories
- [ ] Preserve all 187 historical machine JSON files, original README and import manifest byte-for-byte
- [ ] Publish the complete factory package through a documentation branch and reviewed PR; add durable revision links to this issue set
- [ ] Record all issue URLs, dependencies and case ownership in acceptance/issues.json; regenerate asset hashes after reviewed edits

## Required artifacts

- Reviewed documentation PR and immutable source revision
- Package integrity receipt and unchanged clone hashes
- Issue index and dependency/case coverage report

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 25 issues resolve and all ten phases/43 cases have coverage
- [ ] Required hardware is simulated and generic/template assets are permitted in every case
- [ ] Package verifier passes; no behavioral PASS or admitted state is fabricated

- Related cases: See downstream verification issues.
- Standards: Associated profile/asset classes resolved by EI04/EI05.
- Risks: See linked downstream risk coverage.
